## Root cause found, and it is much bigger than the single test I filed this for

I originally filed this from ONE failure during a `make verify`. A second full `make verify` on
the same host produced **twelve**, and the mechanism is now reproducible without any other
session running.

### The twelve

10 fail directly with `GateCongestedError: gate admission refused: all 4 concurrent slots busy`:

```
tests/unit/test_plan_relation_snapshot.py::test_review_plan_preflight_tolerates_unrelated_untracked_tracker_files
tests/unit/test_plan_review_retry.py::test_retry_fails_closed_when_current_code_sha_is_uncomputable
tests/unit/test_plan_review_retry.py::test_retry_refuses_on_verified_at_sha_mismatch
tests/unit/test_plan_review_reuse.py::test_material_change_reruns_full_review
tests/unit/test_plan_review_reuse.py::test_code_change_reruns_full_review
tests/unit/test_gate_peak_rss_9ea3.py::test_both_gate_entry_points_emit_the_marker[review_plan-plan_review]
tests/unit/test_gate_peak_rss_9ea3.py::test_both_gate_entry_points_emit_the_marker[verify_completion-verify_completion]
tests/unit/workflow/test_gate_error_sidecar.py::test_plan_review_outage_writes_gate_error_and_still_degrades
tests/unit/workflow/test_gate_error_sidecar_heldout.py::test_existing_verdict_readers_skip_gate_error_record
tests/unit/workflow/test_gate_error_sidecar_heldout.py::test_gate_error_verdict_not_coerced_to_fail
```

2 more fail DOWNSTREAM of the same congestion, with a retry-count assertion rather than the
error itself — worth noting because they do not name the cause and would be misdiagnosed:

```
tests/unit/test_plan_review_cli_retry.py::test_cli_retry_refuses_unreviewed_ticket_with_zero_calls  - AssertionError: assert 11 == 2
tests/unit/test_plan_review_cli_retry.py::test_cli_retry_is_compatible_with_no_sign                 - AssertionError: assert 11 == 2
```

(The first `make verify` also caught
`tests/unit/test_completion_wrapper_duration_instrumentation.py::test_verify_completion_partitions_attempt_without_changing_verdict`,
the one this ticket was opened for, so the family is at least thirteen.)

### Deterministic reproduction — it is NOT other sessions, the suite races itself

Running just those twelve, with nothing else on the host:

```
serially            -> 12 passed in 152.57s
-n 4 (run 1)        ->  3 failed, 9 passed
-n 4 (run 2)        ->  4 failed, 8 passed
-n 4 (run 3)        ->  2 failed, 10 passed
```

Fails every time under parallel workers, passes every time serially, and the FAILING SET VARIES
between runs — the signature of a race on a shared resource rather than an order dependency.

### The mechanism: two independent 4s that are the same 4

- `max_concurrent_gates` defaults to **4** (`docs/config.md:597`), and gate admission raises
  `GateCongestedError` at capacity.
- `make test` runs `PYTEST_WORKERS ?= 4` (`Makefile:60`), and CI pins xdist `-n` to the
  runner's real vCPU count — **`ubuntu-latest = 4`** (`.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:789-790`).

Four xdist workers, four gate slots. When four gate-exercising tests land on four workers at
once, the fourth is refused. The admission bound is host-wide and process-crossing, so the
suite's own parallelism is enough to exhaust it; another session holding a real gate (an agent
running `review-plan`) just makes it likelier.

### Why this matters beyond a noisy local run

**This can produce a spurious `Verified -1` on any change**, because the gating CI cell is the
same 4-worker shape. That is a false signal on a merge gate, and per AGENTS.md the response to
a flaky test is to root-cause it rather than `recheck` — which is only possible once the cause
is written down, hence this ticket.

### Discovered from

Bug `5c5c-5741-9b33-47fa` (the ACLI ceiling partition). No overlap: every one of these tests is
in the plan-review / completion-gate area and none references `fetch_paging`, `fetcher`,
`collect_partitioned` or `_ACLI_CEILING`. All twelve pass serially with that change applied.

### Suggested direction (still not investigated in depth)

These are unit tests asserting instrumentation, retry and sidecar behaviour; none of them needs
a real host-wide admission slot. Options, in rough order of preference: stub admission for
tests; give the tests an isolated semaphore; or mark the family with an `xdist_group` so they
never run concurrently (the suite already uses `--dist loadgroup` elsewhere). Setting
`max_concurrent_gates = 0` for the test session disables the bound entirely and would also work,
but it stops exercising the admission path at all, so it is the weakest option.

### Revised acceptance criteria

- [ ] The failure is reproduced deterministically — DONE above: `-n 4` fails, serial passes.
- [ ] All thirteen known tests pass under `-n 4` with a busy host.
- [ ] They no longer depend on host-wide gate admission capacity: they pass with all real slots
      held by another process.
- [ ] What each test actually asserts is still asserted — the fix must not be deleting,
      skipping, or `xfail`-ing them.
- [ ] The two `assert 11 == 2` retry-count tests are confirmed to be the same root cause and
      not a second, independent defect hiding behind it.
- [ ] A sweep for any other test that takes a real gate admission slot.
